input.title: core: best-effort label sync
input.body: Adds label sync to the repo bootstrap.

files.patch:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/core/sync.py
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+import logging
+import requests
+
+LABELS = {"bug": "#d73a4a", "chore": "#cfd8dc"}
+
+
+def sync_labels(session, repo):
+    # TODO: attach retry/backoff once flakiness shows up in practice.
+    try:
+        return session.put("{0}/labels".format(repo), json=LABELS)
+    except requests.RequestException as e:
+        # log-and-continue: label sync is best-effort by design
+        logging.warning("label sync failed: %s", e)
+        return None

note: Globally clean: narrow except, logged, None returned — the documented best-effort contract; TODO is advisory-grade.
